Following up on the split @giskard09 [proposed above](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/2887#issuecomment-6896812678): `responseSchemaHash` before payment, `responseHash` inside a signed receipt at delivery. Both halves now run on x402toll.com, the Base mainnet seller holistis tested. I operate it.

**Before payment.** Each tool's 402 carries `accepts[].extra.responseSchemaHash` and `responseSchemaUrl`. The hash is `"sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(JCS(schema)))` over the `schema` member of the document at that URL, which is free to fetch, for example `https://x402toll.com/v1/response-sche

changes.text:
@kemppelinvestments-del confirmed against the Sourcify exact-match source (`src/JobEscrow.sol` `verdictScheduled`, `src/PayoutScheduleLib.sol`): the five-argument signature, the three reverts, and `0x27101d4c138809c40000` = `[0, 2500, 5000, 7500, 10000]` packed at bits `[16k, 16k+16)`.

Our tooling can call it, and it does not take the mask or the count as input. It reads both from our signed record: bit i is set iff the record's result for `required[i]` (matched by criterion id) is exactly `pass`.
